# Week 6 Start/Sit Briefing — Wednesday, 2026-10-14

## Source and freshness

**Fresh committed fixture, live overlay confirms one player and adds nothing else.** `weekly-report-week-6.json` was generated 2026-10-13T17:11:02Z — after Week 5's Monday-night finale (LA@BUF) and before Week 6's first kickoff (Thursday 10/15) — so it is current; `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)` independently confirms Week 6. Pulled live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` for Week 6 anyway, since this is the Wednesday practice-report run. Result: only **15 rows, covering DEN and SEA** (tonight's Thursday game). Of this roster's eight teams, only **SEA (Jaxon Smith-Njigba)** has filed. LAR, IND, TB, ATL, NYG, NE, CAR and JAX have not. Marked `isLive: false` because the fixture itself still carries last-pull injury/consensus data, even though the one live signal this run exists to check (JSN's practice bucket) did land and is consistent with it.

## Practice report

| Player | Designation | Wednesday practice | Model P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jaxon Smith-Njigba (WR, SEA) | Questionable (ankle) | **Limited Participation** (live, confirmed) | 89.2% |
| Jalen Coker (WR, CAR) | Out (quadriceps) | Unknown — CAR has not filed | 81.5% (flagged, see caveats) |
| TreVeyon Henderson (RB, NE) | Out (ankle) | Unknown — NE has not filed | 3.3% |
| Jaxson Dart (QB, NYG, IR) | IR (season-ending knee) | n/a | 0.1% |

JSN is the only flagged player with a live Wednesday signal this run, and it's a clean one: Limited practice on an ankle issue, and the fitted model's 89.2% is already above the generic Questionable/Limited-bucket average (~70.2%) — consistent with a low-grade issue rather than something structural. He locks tonight (Thursday @DEN) with no further practice reports coming before kickoff.

Jalen Coker and TreVeyon Henderson are both tagged Out, but their model numbers don't agree with each other at all (81.5% vs 3.3%) despite the same tag — see Still uncertain and the caveats. Jaxson Dart is out for the season and not in play either way.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | vs ARI | 21.42 | 96.8% | 22.13 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs TEN | 20.19 | 94.9% | 21.29 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs PIT | 14.24 | 94.9% | 15.02 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba (Q) | @DEN (Thu) | 18.65 | 89.2% | 20.91 |
| WR | Drake London | vs CHI | 17.40 | 96.5% | 18.02 |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | vs NO | 12.40 | 94.4% | 13.14 |
| FLEX | Cam Skattebo | vs NO | 11.71 | 94.9% | 12.35 |
| FLEX | Jalen Coker (Out) | @PHI | 9.39 | 81.5%* | 11.52 |
| K | Dominic Zvada | vs NO | 8.14 | 98.4% | 8.27 |
| DEF | Jaguars D/ST | vs HOU (London) | 8.04 | 100% | 8.04 |
| **Total** | | | **141.58** | | |

\* Don't trust this number at face value — see caveats. Bench: Tyler Shough (15.95, QB), TreVeyon Henderson (0.27, RB, Out). On bye: Sam LaPorta (TE), Jameson Williams (WR), Tee Higgins (WR). IR: Jaxson Dart.

## Changes since Monday

Three forced changes, all bye-driven, none a tactical call:

- **Isaiah Likely in for Sam LaPorta at TE** — LaPorta is on DET's Week 6 bye. Likely is the only other rostered TE.
- **Cam Skattebo in for Jameson Williams at FLEX** — Williams is on DET's Week 6 bye. Skattebo is the only clean (non-Out) bench body left.
- **Jalen Coker in for Tee Higgins at the second FLEX** — Higgins is on CIN's Week 6 bye. This is a real downgrade, not a like-for-like swap: Higgins projected 14.43 last week, Coker projects 9.39 this week and carries his own Out tag. The only other bench option, TreVeyon Henderson, is worse (0.27).

## Still uncertain

- **Jalen Coker's actual status.** Out (quadriceps) per the fixture, no Week 6 CAR practice report yet, and the fixture's own 81.5% P(play) doesn't square with that Out tag (Henderson's Out row sits at 3.3%). He's on Carolina's active roster, not IR, per a live check today — so there's a real chance he's available, and a real chance he isn't. Re-check Thursday/Friday once CAR files; if he's ruled out and nothing has been added, the second FLEX slot is effectively empty this week.
- **The roster-depth hole itself.** This isn't a one-week problem that resolves with more data — it resolves with a waiver add. Today is the deadline flagged in the past two briefings for exactly this Week 6 bye collision, and the 10/8 trade that sent out Matthew Golden removed the one piece that would have covered it.
- **Jaxon Smith-Njigba's final tag** settles with pregame inactives tonight; no more practice data is coming before then.

## Opponent notes

- **NYG @ home vs NO (Sun 1:00pm ET)** is now a three-player stack: Isaiah Likely (TE), Cam Skattebo (FLEX) and Dominic Zvada (K) are all Giants — one bad NYG game script costs three of the ten starting slots at once.
- **Jaguars D/ST plays the early London game vs HOU (Sun 9:30am ET)** — kicks off before every other game this week; nothing about HOU's current form changes the start call.
- **Jalen Coker's Panthers host the Eagles (Sun 1:00pm ET)** — a tough matchup on top of the injury uncertainty, not a reason for optimism if he does suit up.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 6 (this week):** Sam LaPorta, Jameson Williams, Tee Higgins (CIN/DET) — the entire reason tonight's lineup looks the way it does, and the roster has no clean body left to absorb a fourth injury this week.
- **Week 7:** Jaguars D/ST (JAX) — streaming add will be needed that week.
- **Week 8:** Dominic Zvada, Tyler Shough, Cam Skattebo, Isaiah Likely (NYG/NO) — four roster spots on bye the same week; start planning the Week 8 lineup early.
